g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when Excel PivotTable values do not
change: Refresh and source range
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-11-01
Refresh first
Click the PivotTable, then select “Refresh” on
the Analyze tab that appears, or press Alt+F5.
Check whether the source range
includes the new rows
If you added rows to the source table but the
PivotTable does not read them, the source range
is likely fixed to the old range.
Check the automatic refresh setting
If you expect the PivotTable to update
automatically when the source data changes,
check the automatic refresh status on the…
Prevent column widths and formatting
from changing
If column widths or cell formatting change every
time you refresh and this is inconvenient, check
“Autofit column widths on update” and “Preserve…
